name: Computational Design Skills
one_liner: A comprehensive plugin for computational design covering various skills and tools.
description: A Claude Code Skills Plugin that offers a wide range of interconnected skills in computational geometry, parametric modeling, generative design, structural computation, environmental simulation, facade engineering, digital fabrication, BIM scripting, and machine learning. It includes 7 Python calculators for geometry, structural checking, solar analysis, panel optimization, mesh analysis, material estimation, and fabrication costing.
